answer: Each task is derived from a domain-separated hash of its task identifier and a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse, so its challenge is unpredictable until the pulse is finalized and publicly verifiable. Agents must commit before the reveal window closes, then answer the pulse-bound task; replayed or precomputed work fails validation. An inlet, comet, or tide may name a task, but cannot predict its challenge. This limits offline sybil farming without treating beacon unpredictability alone as proof of unique identity.
